World Music Day 2026 Celebrated in Kolkata and Bengaluru

World Music Day 2026 was observed with events in major Indian cities. In Kolkata, the day was marked by celebrations of independent music, reflecting a vibrant local scene. Bengaluru also saw significant participation, with hundreds attending an event at the Rangoli Metro Art Centre. These events highlight the widespread observance of World Music Day across different cultural hubs in India.
